attempts.raw: {"risk": 2, "reason": "Adds a new TryConvert override for implicit dynamic conversions on JsonDynamicValue, well covered by expanded tests, but touches a core low-level dynamic abstraction used widely for content items so subtle behavior changes (e.g. exception swallowing, default value type coercion) could ripple into many modules relying on dynamic JSON access."}

reason: Adds a new TryConvert override for implicit dynamic conversions on JsonDynamicValue, well covered by expanded tests, but touches a core low-level dynamic abstraction used widely for content items so subtle behavior changes (e.g. exception swallowing, default value type coercion) could ripple into many modules relying on dynamic JSON access.
